description: Resource attributes for registration-form authoring under a verified event organizer.

eventId.description: Owning event identifier used by event-role assignments.

workflowId.description: Registration workflow identifier when the operation targets workflow requirements.

formId.description: Registration form identifier when one already exists.

versionId.description: Registration form version identifier for version-scoped operations.

status.description: Current form-version status when lifecycle state affects the operation.

isMachine.description: Server-derived machine-caller marker; machine authoring always fails closed.

organizerActorId.description: Verified organizer actor identifier supplied by server-side event loading.

organizerUserId.description: Verified organizer user identifier supplied by server-side event loading.

organizerOrganizationId.description: Verified organizer organization identifier supplied by server-side event loading.

organizerGroupId.description: Verified organizer group identifier supplied by server-side event loading.

submittedByUserId.description: Original listing submitter; never grants form-authoring authority.
